Truxton is one of Toaplan's great classics, which says a lot considering their catalog also includes shoot 'em up juggernauts like Batsugun, Zero Wing, and many others.

Brought to you by Tatsujin, founded by Toaplan executive Masahiro Yuge, this new edition to a legendary franchise is an evolution of Truxton. It’s packed with great features, new graphics, new sounds, even a brand new interactive digital comic! 

Why not to try it for yourself? Truxton Extreme has a demo available throughout Next Fest. check it out here:

This demo version includes a limited set of features to give you a good feel for Truxton Extreme ahead of its full release. (It also lets you face off against an iconic boss returning from the original game...)

So, what are you waiting for? Go play Truxton Extreme!

notes.title: OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars is OUT NOW
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45245741/f87e1fcc723e9cfa2c6a3c53321117bd9f1388fd.png[/img]

It's Takaya Imamura Day! Or, as it’s also known, the launch day of OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars! That’s right, today marks the long-awaited release of the legendary Nintendo illustrator’s latest adventure. And it’s a truly special one. OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars is a retro-inspired space adventure for anyone who has ever fallen in love with the 16-bit aesthetic of the ‘90s. It tells the story of the androids Thunder and Kyla as they search for a new planet for humanity.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x4utzzsS9Rg

One of the absolute best things about OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars is the vast number of wonderful creatures and aliens you’ll encounter on your journey. But that’s hardly surprising. After all, Takaya Imamura is the man behind characters like Captain Falcon (F-Zero), Fox McCloud (Star Fox), and Tingle (The Legend of Zelda). He’s also joined by Shinobu Amayake, who worked on the soundtrack for Stunt Race FX. A true 16-bit composer, in other words!

But enough talk. It’s time for you to head into the cosmos. A grand adventure among the stars awaits!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3128580/OMEGA_6_The_Triangle_Stars/

notes.title: DARK HORSE AND LEGENDARY GAME DESIGNER TAKAYA IMAMURA BRINGS THE COLORFUL CAST OF OMEGA 6 THE TRIANGLE STARS TO ENGLISH MANGA FANS
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45245741/f87e1fcc723e9cfa2c6a3c53321117bd9f1388fd.png[/img]

[b]Imamura's adventure "Omega 6" manga is available in English for the first time![/b]

Based on the upcoming pixel-art adventure game Omega 6 The Triangle Stars, Dark Horse Comics presents Takaya Imamura's (Star Fox, F-Zero) Omega 6, a complete story in one manga volume. This will be available for English readers in October 2025. Translated by award-winning manga translator Zack Davisson (H.P. Lovecraft's The Colour out of Space, Cat + Gamer), the 16-bit video game revolution is coming to comics!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45245741/aa95a3775e78c5ac1974420331ea14a48edb80d2.jpg[/img]

Creator Takaya Imamura had this to say about bringing the original manga to English readers in conjunction with the game. "I sincerely hope that my manga and games can be enjoyed by people regardless of where they live, and it would make me very happy if my work delivers an exciting and thrilling experience!"

[b]In Omega 6:
[/b]
After awakening from a rejuvenating months-long stasis, androids Thunder and Kyla are ready to spring back into bounty-hunting action! With the aid of some peculiar magic fruits, the pair enter a nearly invincible berserker state. However, there's a catch—once the effect wears off, they will age rapidly and become feeble until they can return to their recovery pods. Their current target, an assassin named Petrogaze, carries an appealing $300 million credit bounty on his head. The job seems easy: the duo plans to power up, bag the bad guy, and be home before dinner. But Petrogaze is much tougher than anticipated! Forced to consume their fruits early, the bounty hunters are suddenly on a life-or-death timer. Dinner's gonna have to wait! 

"The videogame version is a totally different story,” confirms Junji Seki, Game Director and President of Happymeal. “Set in the same world as the Omega 6 comic, full of drama-infused encounters and battles with the 100 plus unique aliens created by Imamura-san. I hope you enjoy the adventures of Thunder and Kyla in the game as well as the comic; you may even discover characters making an appearance in both!"
 
Omega 6 is an action-packed ride, with 216 pages (5.75" x 8.25") of retro-futuristic fun in a paperback left-to-right style. Lock in on your target when it arrives in bookstores and comic shops on October 21, 2025 for $14.99. Pre-order now from TFAW, Amazon, Barnes and Noble, or your local bookstore, or visit [url=https://www.comicshoplocator.com/]Comic Shop Locator[/url] for more details and stores near you. 

Wishlist Omega 6 The Triangle Stars on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3128580/OMEGA_6_The_Triangle_Stars/

notes.title: Introducing the Toaplan & Psikyo Classic Arcade Shoot ‘em up Collection
notes.notes:
Introducing the Toaplan & Psikyo Classic Arcade Shoot ‘em up Collection
The Japanese studios Toaplan and Psikyo created some of the most groundbreaking and greatest shoot ‘em up games from the early 80’s and up until the start of the 2000’s including beloved series such as Truxton and Strikers 1945.

We’re now teaming up with City Connection to bring you the Toaplan & Psikyo Classic Arcade Shoot ‘em up Collection! This bundle includes 16 games from Toaplan and 9 games from Psikyo filled with fast-flying bullets and bombastic bombing action.

If you already own some of these games, then you will just pay and receive the games in the bundle that you don’t already have in your Steam library. Take the chance to enjoy some of the finest arcade experiences from the golden era – updated with modern features.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43964/Toaplan_X_Psikyo_Collection/]Toaplan & Psikyo Classic Arcade Shoot 'em up Collection[/url]

GAMES INCLUDED

Toaplan games:

[list]
[*] Batsugun
[*] Truxton
[*] Truxton II
[*] Zero Wing
[*] Out Zone
[*] FixEight
[*] Dogyuun
[*] Grind Stormer
[*] Vimana
[*] Slap Fight
[*] Tiger Heli
[*] Twin Cobra
[*] Flying Shark
[*] Fire Shark
[*] Hellfire
[*] Twin Hawk
[/list]

Psikyo games:

[list]
[*] Strikers 1945
[*] Strikers 1945 II
[*] Strikers 1945 III
[*] Gunbird
[*] Gunbird 2
[*] Gunbarich
[*] Samurai Aces
[*] Tengai
[*] Samurai Aces III: Sengoku Cannon
[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43179534/c019c1fdce51060416087563fb16b0a6ed417d5c.png[/img]

Psikyo was a Japanese developer and publisher founded in 1992. Specializing in vertically scrolling shoot ‘em up that are known for fast-flying enemy bullets, challenging second loops, and enigmatic characters. Development studio Zerodiv, part of City Connection, have carefully ported Psikyo’s classic arcade games to PC.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43179534/b475adada233a8f922ba57c9ab93093303341d1b.png[/img]

Toaplan was a Japanese developer that operated between 1984 and 1994. Famous for popularizing the bomb-based gameplay system that became a staple in shoot ‘em ups, and perfectly balanced enemy placement and attack patterns that required a strategic approach. Today Toaplan is curated by Tatsujin with many of the former key Toaplan staff employed at Tatsujin. Bitwave have ported Toaplan’s slate of immortal shoot ‘em ups to PC.

notes.title: The final Toaplan volume is out now!

We’re also launching an Ultimate Collection with all 16 games for the unrivaled Toaplan experience.

The Toaplan PC project was announced back in August 2022, and the circle is now complete. At Bitwave, we take great pride in our collaboration with Tatsujin, aiding them in continuing the Toaplan legacy making games like Dogyuun available in home versions for the first time.

[b]Grind Stormer: [/b]Experience a vertically scrolling manic shooter featuring impressive pixel art graphics and an upbeat FM soundtrack!‍

notes.title: The Audio of Toaplan
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43179534/6afa1964bd846a8ddf2af281bf909c5e84a6fd16.png[/img]

The Toaplan games are known for their thrilling music that matches the intense shoot ‘em up gameplay. Taking off in Truxton and you immediately feel a level excitement as the music starts to play, it’s the start of an action-packed journey to furthest reaches of space. Or the dramatic straight into action upbeat tune of Hellfire. Add the sound effects of blazing shots and exploding bombs. It’s a soundscape that represents the best of the golden arcade era of pixelated shoot ‘em up games.

At Bitwave we have worked to constantly improving the audio representation. Coder Carl Henrik Skårstedt has listened (no pun intended) to feedback and received input from Tatsujin, the owner of the Toaplan games and run by original Toaplan staff including Masahiro Yuge and Tatsuya Uemura that composed several of the songs in the game.

To ensure proper emulation we listened to recorded arcade music and sound effects. It’s a challenge as the audio experience with an arcade cabinet can vary between cabinets with different speakers and resonance. The sound from earlier sound chips such as the PSG depends on the circuitry connecting it to the sound output signal making each game a little bit more unique and more challenging to get just right.

Throughout several different patches we have worked on the audio:

- Improved the sound to play at a consistent tempo.
- Included support for a wider range of audio drivers.
- Added audio filter: optional echo, reverb, low-pass and high-pass filters to allow players to customize to their best experience in emulating an arcade like sound.
- Fixed technical bugs that meant minor improvements in the generated audio.

In the latest update we’ve further adjusted the frequency based on feedback of the sound effects and the high pitch in games such as Slap Fight based on feedback. This is something that’ll also benefit future releases such as Tiger Heli, the first game created by Toaplan. We hope that this is satisfaction to your ears in the goal to deliver the arcade feeling home on your PC.

We’re humble as it’s not an easy task to emulate and faithfully recreate the amazing Toaplan audio with the weight of heritage it carries. We appreciate specific feedback on how and where we can improve. Our goal remains to deliver an arcade experience with minimal input lag for the controller to get that split-second action decisions as you dodge bullets, while you enjoy the beautiful pixel art with or without a CRT filter and feel the beat of the stunning digitized music.

We want to finish off by letting you know that the latest update also includes a fix for the capture video function. Previously we fixed the desync and in the new version we have turned off rewind when recording and replaying. At first the fix will be applied to Twin Cobra, Flying Shark, and Slap Fight. The fix will be rolled out to the other games in the future.

Other fixes in addition to the already mentioned:
● Music tempo correction (Twin Cobra, and Flying Shark)
● Wide screen mode: Pick-ups centered instead of to the left side (Twin Cobra)
● Centered the cursor in the high score entry (Slap Fight)

[*] Audio filter: Optional Echo, Reverb, Low-Pass and High-Pass filters added
[*] Bug fix: The Save/Load and Start Replay menus now scroll if you have more than eight saves or replays
[*] Resolution fix: Allow UI scaling of 200% for exceptionally high resolution monitors
[*] Rewind fix: Fixed issue where rewinding while recording would break and desync the recording
[*] Replay fix: Starting a recording now prevents you from rewinding further back than from the start of the recording
[*] Save/Load fix: The game no longer crashes when you open the save/load menu if you have more than 32 save files
[*] Replay fix: The game no longer crashes when you open the replay menu if you have more than 32 recordings
[*] Controller fix: Added a shortcut to open the Steam Input controller remapping window from the Input menu, if Steam Input is selected
[*] Bug fix: Toggling fullscreen with ALT+ENTER no longer closes the pause menu
[*] Save/Load fix: When loading quick saves players are requested to press start to assign controllers to each player
[*] Bug fix: Fixed Insert Coin when using Raw Input and joined a game
[*] Fullscreen fix: The game now launches in fullscreen mode if launched via Steam Big Picture Mode
[*] Updated menu navigation: added scrolling where appropriate and improved navigation logic for menus with multiple columns
[*] Rewind update: Added the ability to rewind faster by holding the speedup button and the rewind button simultaneously
[*] Rewind fix: You can now fast-rewind and fast-forward with the left and right bumpers in the rewind UI
[*] Bug fix: Fixed bug where the pause menu logo was shown in the rewind UI
[*] Leaderboards fix: Scores achieved in Practice Mode are no longer uploaded to the leaderboards
[*] Leaderboard fix: Entries with invalid details (area counter, shot counter etc) no longer display any details

notes.title: Important information regarding high-score entries
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43179534/d864460aa36835120e94943936f8ec87a865e1c1.png[/img]

Shmupers! Listen! 

We've got some highly important information regarding high-score entries in Out Zone, Zero Wing, and Twin Cobra. [b]Please read the information below carefully.[/b]

Unfortunately, some older leaderboard entries in Out Zone, Zero Wing, and Twin Cobra contain incorrect metadata. This metadata is the additional information displayed next to your score, such as the number of bullets fired, enemies destroyed, and so on. 

Currently, this incorrect metadata is displayed even though the data does not make any sense. 

With the latest patch coming soon, we've set it up so that when we detect that the stored metadata is incorrect, we simply don't render it in the UI. Instead, only the score, username, and ranking will be displayed.

The underlying issue that caused this incorrect metadata should now be solved, and any scores you achieve now and in the future will have correct metadata. 

Additionally, this issue ONLY affected metadata - which means the saved scores are correct regardless of whether the metadata is visible.

We're sorry about this. Thank you for understanding!

We have updated Zero Wing, Truxton, Twin Cobra, and Out Zone with the latest patch containing several updates. Updating will help ensure a smoother and more stable gameplay experience. 

For Zero Wing, we spent months creating a reimagined version of the famous intro cutscene that spawned the world-class meme "All your base are belong to us." The original arcade version of Zero Wing never got an intro of its own. We are thrilled to offer you the famous intro as part of today's update. 

[previewyoutube=hWlNx_R3q6g;full][/previewyoutube]

There are some differences from what you're used to, but don't worry. All the good stuff is still there. It's a great addition, along with the other updates. We hope you love it! We'll continue to add improvements, fixes, and features in the future, so please stay tuned for more!

[b]Full patch notes:[/b]

[b]Zero Wing[/b]
[list]
[*] Intro cutscene added: Choose either the English or Japanese version
[*] Steam Controller Refresh: Fixes for Xbox controller, added support for Xbox 360 controller, fix for 8bitdo arcade stick RT/LT
[*] Steam Input Fire: Fire Button (without auto fire) is now functional
[*] Raw Input Button Icons: We’ve begun adding additional button icons for known controller types
[*] Japanese language set by default if the system language is Japanese (unless saved in the config file)
[*] Death counter: Fixed detection of player death

notes.title: Four Toaplan SHMUP Classics are Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43179534/dca9427abd25179b6231a62de08ec0cc2e2452f4.png[/img]

It's here! Toaplan Arcade Shoot 'Em Up Collection Vol.1 is finally out on Steam! We at Bitwave are proud to have worked on this project with our Japanese friends at Tatsujin. Vol. 1 includes four Toaplan classics with high-quality emulation and tons of quality-of-life extras.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AwXoPPNx5QY

[b]Games included in Vol. 1 (available as a bundle or separately):[/b]
[list]
[*] Zero Wing - Cult co-op shooter famous for "All your base" is now available on PC!
[*] Out Zone - Hardcore co-op run-and-gun classic available for the first time outside the arcades!
[*] Twin Cobra - Fly solo or play together in this fast-paced aerial shmup! Available for the first time on PC!
[*] Truxton - Blood-pumping sci-fi shmup with massive stages and awesome weapons. Out now for the first time on PC!
[/list]

Each game features quick save/resume, online leaderboards for single credit players, no assist and assisted modes, and Achievements (for bragging rights)! You can also showcase your skills online using the built-in video capture!

[b]List of updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Authentic emulation with minimal input lag (input processing and rendering are all done on the same frame).
[*] Instrument panels with additional gameplay information and artwork.
[*] Gameplay can be rewinded between 10 and 18 minutes.
[*] Assist features such as auto-fire.
[*] Very Easy Mode, allowing beginners to master each game at their own pace.
[*] Pixel-perfect display or full-screen scaling in both windowed and full-screen modes.
[*] Rotate the game in 90-degree increments.
[*] Choose between Raw Input on Windows or Steam Input.
[*] You can practice your skills using the practice mode. 
[*] ... and more!
[/list]

Putting together this collection of beloved shooters was so much fun, and we hope you love it. Our team is working hard on Vol. 2 right now, and we'll let you know as soon as it's ready. 

For now, let's get to work pumping lead into our enemies! We can't wait to see your high scores!

Follow us on [url=http://www.twitter.com/bitwavegames]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Wishlist Truxton and Twin Cobra today!
notes.notes:
Today’s an exciting day for us at Bitwave Games! We’re happy to tell you that Truxton and Twin Cobra, the two final additions to the first Toaplan arcade shooter bundle, are up for wishlisting on Steam. 🚀

Developer Carl-Henrik Skårstedt is here to spill all the details:

[previewyoutube=evlB47kaqRU;full][/previewyoutube]

We announced the Toaplan project in August with our Freemode friends at Tatsujin, and we’re super excited to bring these arcade gems to a new generation of gamers. The games will feature a variety of quality-of-life and accessibility enhancements, such as achievements, online leaderboards, arcade-accurate graphics, auto-checkpoints, an optional Very Easy mode, sidebar indicators, and complete input configuration. All these features will also be available in the rest of the upcoming Toaplan titles.The first Toaplan bundle will be available on Steam and GOG later this year.
